subject: Renewal + Capacity Add-on — billing treasury migration & invoice cadence
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jana Kline <jana.kline@acmetech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Capacity Add-on — billing treasury migration & invoice cadence

Hi Jana —

Thanks again for the time last week. Quick follow-up as we finalize the renewal + capacity add-on: we want to ensure invoicing and treasury routing are aligned so your finance team sees no interruption. A few concrete items we need from Acme to close the order and bill cleanly:

- Confirm PO number (or send the PO PDF) and the intended invoicing entity
- Confirm billing contact for invoice delivery and AP email
- Which net terms should we reflect on the invoice (Net30 / Net45 / Net60)? You mentioned Net45 in the call; confirm if that still stands
- We need a W9 for AcmeTech on file (or equivalent tax doc) — I attached the latest SOW for reference

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW + pricing redlines)

If you can send the procurement PO draft and the W9, Grace will validate the invoice routing and Priyom will lock the capacity start date. Our goal: have billing path and PO in place before the renewal effective date (2027-04-01) so the first invoice matches your treasury requirements.

Happy to jump on a short call with procurement if helpful.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Jana Kline <jana.kline@acmetech.com>

Cc: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@acmetech.com>, AcmeTech Procurement <procurement@acmetech.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity Add-on — billing treasury migration & invoice cadence

Sean —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Procurement is preparing a PO draft and we expect to route it through our treasury/payments team. A few notes from our side:

- We will issue a formal PO (attached as draft) — PO number will be assigned once legal signs the amendment.
- Our treasury wants the invoices sent to invoices@acmetech-payments.com (AP inbox). Please include the PO number on the invoice line items.
- Preferred net terms: we are proposing Net45, but I'll confirm with Treasury; Oliver is copied to expedite.
- W9: we can produce a W9 for the billing entity but need to confirm the remit-to entity first (we have two US entities).

Attaching: Acme_PO_Draft_2027.pdf

We'll aim to finalize the PO and remit entity by Wednesday. If Redwood needs a separate invoice for the capacity add-on vs. the renewal base, let us know — procurement prefers consolidated invoices but can accept two invoices if the PO references both line items clearly.

Thanks —
Jana Kline
Procurement Manager, AcmeTech
jana.kline@acmetech.com

Attachment: Acme_PO_Draft_2027.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jana Kline <jana.kline@acmetech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity Add-on — billing treasury migration & invoice cadence

Thanks Jana — this helps a lot. A few follow-ups from our billing ops perspective:

- We can consolidate into a single invoice that enumerates the renewal term + capacity add-on as separate line items. That will preserve one PO reference and a single AP email.
- Grace will set invoice delivery to invoices@acmetech-payments.com once you confirm the remit-to entity. Grace — once Jana confirms, can you please: (1) validate the EIN/w9 match, (2) set the remit-to account in Stripe / our billing ledger, and (3) publish the invoice schedule to the shared drive.
- On net terms: Redwood standard for this account has been Net30; if Acme requires Net45 we can accept for this renewal but need it documented in the amendment to avoid mismatch with automated prorate/early-termination calculations. Priyom — can you please add a note in the deal record and update the billing SOW to reflect Net45 if procurement confirms?

Action items for Acme: send final PO (with PO number), confirm remit-to entity name + EIN, and W9. Ideally we receive those by COB Wed 2027-03-10 to keep the renewal effective 2027-04-01 without invoice delay.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ACME-RENEWAL-2027 (will upload invoice schedule once remit entity confirmed)

Thanks,
Sean

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity Add-on — billing treasury migration & invoice cadence

Sean / Jana — quick note from Treasury side: PO will be finalized today and PO number created (PO# A-2027-5489). We can provide a scanned PO and W9 for the selected US entity by EOD. One request from our AR team: can Redwood issue the first invoice on the renewal effective date (2027-04-01) and apply Net30 instead of Net45? Our team is asking for Net30 to keep the payment cadence aligned with other vendors for Q2. If Redwood needs Net45 documented in the amendment to accept extended terms, let us know — otherwise we'll take Net30.

I'll upload the signed PO and W9 to the folder and send the AP mailbox a heads-up.

Thanks,
